raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The multi-pool v2 storage API (`batch_exists_v2`/`batch_get_v2`/`batch_set_v2`) was added in #20457, and backends are expected to override all three methods to serve multi-pool cache stacks. Three backends never got that update: aibrix, simm, and eic. The base class defaults just raise `NotImplementedError`.

So this combination is selectable today:

- hybrid model (Mamba/SWA/DSA, anything that creates sidecar pools) + one of those backends
- the server starts fine, accepts requests
- the first storage transfer hits `batch_exists_v2` and dies with a bare `NotImplementedError`, no hint about which config knob is wrong

The lookup path calls it as soon as `pool_transfers` is non-empty, so this is not a corner case. It will always crash once the storage layer sees traffic.

This change makes the failure happen at attach time instead, with an error that names the backend and the sidecar pools and says what to do about it.

## Modifications

- `HiCacheStorage.supports_pool_transfers()`: classmethod that checks whether the backend overrides the three v2 methods. No hardcoded backend list, a backend advertises support by overriding, same as the rest of the API.
- `HybridCacheController.attach_storage_backend()` now validates sidecar pool support after `super()` attaches. If the host pool group has non-anchor pools and the backend lacks the v2 methods, it raises `ValueError` naming the backend and pools, and rolls the attach back through `detach_storage_backend()` so nothing stays half-wired. This covers both the startup attach and the runtime admin attach path.
- `register_host_pool_entry()` runs the same check for sidecars registered after attach (decode retraction backup pools, draft sidecars). The entry is rejected before it lands in the pool group.
- Anchor-only stacks are not affected. Plain MHA/MLA models on a v1-only backend never issue v2 transfers, so existing setups keep working.

## Accuracy Tests

No model output changes. This converts a late crash into an early one, control path only.

New unit tests in `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_sidecar_backend_gate.py` (CPU, no GPU needed):

- probe reports no support for the base class and for a partial override (overriding one of the three methods must not count as support)
- v1 backend + sidecar pools raises at attach, message contains the missing API names and the pool names
- v2 backend + sidecar pools attaches fine
- v1 backend + anchor-only stack attaches fine (no behavior change for existing setups)
- gate failure rolls the attach back (`enable_storage` back to False, `storage_backend` cleared)
- late sidecar registration on a v1 backend is rejected before mutating the pool group
- aibrix/simm/eic are checked from source via AST, since their vendor SDKs are optional dependencies and cannot be imported in CI

I could not run an end-to-end GPU test with a real hybrid model plus aibrix/simm/eic, those need vendor SDKs (`aibrix_kvcache`, Scitix simm lib, AWS EIC infra). The gate logic itself is covered by the mock tests above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

One method-identity comparison per attach. Nothing added to the serving path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (nothing to document in my view, the error message carries the explanation; can add a note to the HiCache docs if maintainers want)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (not applicable, no inference path change)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Would also appreciate a run-ci label so CI can actually exercise it. Thanks!

@@ -300,6 +300,26 @@ class HiCacheStorage(ABC):
     def register_mem_pool_host(self, mem_pool_host: HostKVCache):
         self.mem_pool_host = mem_pool_host
 
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_pool_transfers(cls) -> bool:
+        """Whether this backend implements the multi-pool v2 batch API.
+
+        Multi-pool (sidecar) cache stacks -- hybrid Mamba/SWA/DSA models,
+        draft pools, decode-retraction backups -- route every page transfer
+        through ``batch_exists_v2``/``batch_get_v2``/``batch_set_v2`` with one
+        ``PoolTransfer`` per pool. Backends that do not override those methods
+        inherit base-class stubs that raise ``NotImplementedError``, so the
+        combination used to fail mid-serving with an opaque crash instead of
+        being rejected at attach time. A backend advertises the capability by
+        overriding the methods; this probe keeps the answer derived from the
+        class itself, so new backends need no registry update.
+        """
+        return (
+            cls.batch_exists_v2 is not HiCacheStorage.batch_exists_v2
+            and cls.batch_get_v2 is not HiCacheStorage.batch_get_v2
+            and cls.batch_set_v2 is not HiCacheStorage.batch_set_v2
+        )
+
     def register_mem_host_pool_v2(self, host_pool: HostKVCache, host_pool_name):
         if not hasattr(self, "registered_pools"):
             self.registered_pools = {}

@@ -339,10 +339,14 @@ def attach_storage_backend(
                 model_name=model_name,
                 storage_backend_extra_config=storage_backend_extra_config,
             )
+            self._validate_sidecar_pool_support(host_pools)
         except Exception:
             if self.pp_prefetch_command_group is not None:
                 torch.distributed.destroy_process_group(self.pp_prefetch_command_group)
                 self.pp_prefetch_command_group = None
+            # Roll the attach back to the base controller's clean state, so a
+            # rejected runtime attach leaves nothing half-wired.
+            self.detach_storage_backend()
             raise
 
         for entry in host_pools or []:
@@ -358,9 +362,43 @@ def detach_storage_backend(self):
             self.pp_prefetch_states.clear()
             self.pp_prefetch_decisions.clear()
 
+    def _validate_sidecar_pool_support(
+        self, host_pools: Optional[list[PoolEntry]] = None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Reject v1-only backends before any sidecar pool can route through them.
+
+        A non-anchor host pool (Mamba/SWA/DSA sidecar, draft or retraction
+        backup pool) makes the cache stack issue v2 multi-pool transfers
+        against this backend. Failing here -- at attach time, on the scheduler
+        control path -- replaces the previous behavior where the first v2
+        transfer raised a bare ``NotImplementedError`` mid-serving.
+        """
+        if self.storage_backend is None:
+            return
+        extra_pools = [
+            entry for entry in host_pools or [] if not entry.is_primary_index_anchor
+        ]
+        if not extra_pools:
+            return
+        if self.storage_backend.supports_pool_transfers():
+            return
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Storage backend "
+            f"'{self.storage_backend_type}' "
+            f"({type(self.storage_backend).__name__}) does not implement the "
+            f"multi-pool v2 storage API (batch_exists_v2/batch_get_v2/"
+            f"batch_set_v2), which is required by the sidecar pools "
+            f"{[entry.name.value for entry in extra_pools]} of this model's "
+            f"cache stack. Without it the first multi-pool transfer would "
+            f"crash mid-serving. Use a backend that supports multi-pool "
+            f"transfers (e.g. mooncake, hf3fs, nixl, file) or a "
+            f"v1-compatible model configuration."
+        )
+
     def register_host_pool_entry(self, entry: PoolEntry) -> None:
         if not isinstance(self.mem_pool_host, HostPoolGroup):
             raise TypeError("Dynamic HiCache sidecars require HostPoolGroup.")
+        self._validate_sidecar_pool_support([entry])
         self.mem_pool_host.add_entry(entry)
         if not entry.is_primary_index_anchor:
             self.extra_host_mem_release_queues.setdefault(entry.name, Queue())

+# Copyright 2023-2026 SGLang Team

+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#

+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+# ==============================================================================
+"""Attach-time rejection of v1-only backends on multi-pool cache stacks.
+
+Hybrid cache stacks (Mamba/SWA/DSA sidecars, draft pools, retraction backup
+pools) route page transfers through the v2 multi-pool API
+(``batch_exists_v2``/``batch_get_v2``/``batch_set_v2``). Backends that do not
+override those methods inherit base-class stubs that raise
+``NotImplementedError``. Before this gate, the combination failed mid-serving
+on the first storage transfer; now ``attach_storage_backend`` and
+``register_host_pool_entry`` reject it up front with an actionable error.
+
+    python3 -m pytest test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_sidecar_backend_gate.py -v
+"""
+
+import threading
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any, List, Optional
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheStorage, PoolName
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache.hybrid_cache_controller import (
+    HybridCacheController,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host import HostPoolGroup, PoolEntry
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage import StorageBackendFactory
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PAGE = 16
+
+
+class V1OnlyBackend(HiCacheStorage):
+    """A backend that only implements the v1 surface (like aibrix/simm/eic).
+
+    Inherits the v2 stubs from HiCacheStorage without overriding them: the
+    capability probe must report "no v2" through inheritance alone.
+    """
+
+    def get(
+        self,
+        key: str,
+        target_location: Any = None,
+        target_sizes: Any = None,
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    def batch_get(self, keys, target_locations=None, target_sizes=None):
+        return []
+
+    def set(
+        self,
+        key: str,
+        value: Any = None,
+        target_location: Any = None,
+        target_sizes: Any = None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def batch_set(
+        self, keys, values=None, target_locations=None, target_sizes=None
+    ) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def exists(self, key: str) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+    # Registration surface used by attach_storage_backend.
+    def register_mem_pool_host(self, mem_pool_host: Any) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def register_mem_host_pool_v2(self, host_pool: Any, host_pool_name: Any) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def on_host_pools_registered(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+
+class V2Backend(V1OnlyBackend):
+    """A backend that overrides the full v2 surface (like mooncake/hf3fs)."""
+
+    def batch_exists_v2(self, keys, pool_transfers=None, extra_info=None):
+        return None  # content irrelevant to the gate
+
+    def batch_get_v2(self, transfers, extra_info=None):
+        return None
+
+    def batch_set_v2(self, transfers, extra_info=None):
+        return None
+
+
+def _fake_pool(name: str) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """The HostPoolGroup surface, without CUDA."""
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        name=name,
+        layout="page_first",
+        page_size=PAGE,
+        device="cpu",
+        size=128,
+        logical_size=128,
+        can_use_write_back_jit=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _entry(name: PoolName, pool: Any, is_anchor: bool = False) -> PoolEntry:
+    return PoolEntry(
+        name=name,
+        host_pool=pool,
+        device_pool=SimpleNamespace(),
+        layer_mapper=lambda layer: layer,
+        is_primary_index_anchor=is_anchor,
+    )
+
+
+def _group() -> HostPoolGroup:
+    return HostPoolGroup(
+        [
+            _entry(PoolName.KV, _fake_pool("kv"), is_anchor=True),
+            _entry(PoolName.MAMBA, _fake_pool("mamba")),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def _controller(group: HostPoolGroup) -> HybridCacheController:
+    """Only the attributes ``attach_storage_backend`` reads."""
+    controller = object.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+    controller.enable_storage = False
+    controller.storage_stop_event = threading.Event()
+    controller.storage_host_pool = group.anchor_entry.host_pool
+    controller.mem_pool_host = group
+    controller.page_size = PAGE
+    controller.host_memory_mode = "cache"
+    controller.tp_group = None
+    controller.attn_cp_group = None
+    controller.attn_tp_group = None
+    controller.pp_group = None
+    controller.prefetch_hits_sync_groups = []
+    controller.prefetch_completion_sync_groups = []
+    controller.pp_prefetch_command_thread = None
+    controller.pp_prefetch_command_group = None
+    controller.pp_prefetch_states = {}
+    controller.pp_prefetch_decisions = {}
+    controller.pp_prefetch_state_lock = threading.Lock()
+    controller.extra_host_mem_release_queues = {}
+    return controller
+
+
+def _attach(
+    controller: Any, backend: Any, host_pools: Optional[List[PoolEntry]]
+) -> None:
+    """Run ``attach_storage_backend`` with the heavy pieces stubbed out."""
+    storage_config = SimpleNamespace(is_mla_model=False, extra_config={})
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(
+            StorageBackendFactory, "create_backend", return_value=backend
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            controller, "_generate_storage_config", return_value=storage_config
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(controller, "_start_storage_threads"),
+    ):
+        controller.attach_storage_backend(
+            storage_backend="dynamic", host_pools=host_pools
+        )
+
+
+class TestSupportsPoolTransfersProbe(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_v1_only_backend_reports_no_support(self):
+        self.assertFalse(V1OnlyBackend.supports_pool_transfers())
+
+    def test_v2_backend_reports_support(self):
+        self.assertTrue(V2Backend.supports_pool_transfers())
+
+    def test_base_class_reports_no_support(self):
+        self.assertFalse(HiCacheStorage.supports_pool_transfers())
+
+    def test_partial_override_reports_no_support(self):
+        # Overriding only one of the three v2 methods must NOT advertise
+        # support: the other two calls would still hit the raising stub.
+
+        class PartialBackend(V1OnlyBackend):
+            def batch_exists_v2(self, keys, pool_transfers=None, extra_info=None):
+                return None
+
+        self.assertFalse(PartialBackend.supports_pool_transfers())
+
+    def test_real_v1_backends_report_no_support(self):
+        # The three backends known to lack the v2 surface today. Their vendor
+        # SDKs are optional dependencies, so verify from source instead of
+        # importing: the class must not define any of the three v2 methods.
+        import ast
+        import inspect
+        from pathlib import Path
+
+        mem_cache_dir = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(HiCacheStorage) or ".").parent
+        backend_files = {
+            "AibrixKVCacheStorage": "storage/aibrix_kvcache/aibrix_kvcache_storage.py",
+            "EICStorage": "storage/eic/eic_storage.py",
+            "HiCacheSiMM": "storage/simm/hicache_simm.py",
+        }
+        for class_name, rel_path in backend_files.items():
+            tree = ast.parse((mem_cache_dir / rel_path).read_text())
+            classes = [
+                node
+                for node in ast.walk(tree)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == class_name
+            ]
+            self.assertEqual(len(classes), 1, f"{class_name} not found in {rel_path}")
+            methods = {
+                item.name
+                for item in classes[0].body
+                if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)
+            }
+            v2_methods = {"batch_exists_v2", "batch_get_v2", "batch_set_v2"}
+            overridden = methods & v2_methods
+            self.assertFalse(
+                overridden,
+                f"{class_name} appears to override {sorted(overridden)}; "
+                f"update the gate expectations",
+            )
+
+    def test_real_v2_backends_report_support(self):
+        # HiCacheFile is stdlib-only, so probe it directly; hf3fs/nixl need
+        # optional vendor SDKs, so verify from source the same way.
+        import ast
+        import inspect
+        from pathlib import Path
+
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheFile
+
+        self.assertTrue(HiCacheFile.supports_pool_transfers())
+
+        mem_cache_dir = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(HiCacheFile) or ".").parent
+        backend_files = {
+            "HiCacheHF3FS": "storage/hf3fs/storage_hf3fs.py",
+            "HiCacheNixl": "storage/nixl/hicache_nixl.py",
+        }
+        v2_methods = {"batch_exists_v2", "batch_get_v2", "batch_set_v2"}
+        for class_name, rel_path in backend_files.items():
+            tree = ast.parse((mem_cache_dir / rel_path).read_text())
+            classes = [
+                node
+                for node in ast.walk(tree)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == class_name
+            ]
+            self.assertEqual(len(classes), 1, f"{class_name} not found in {rel_path}")
+            methods = {
+                item.name
+                for item in classes[0].body
+                if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)
+            }
+            self.assertTrue(
+                v2_methods <= methods,
+                f"{class_name} is missing {sorted(v2_methods - methods)}; "
+                f"update the gate expectations",
+            )
+
+
+class TestAttachTimeGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        # The attach path resolves derived parallel widths (e.g. attn_dcp_size)
+        # from the published runtime context, so a case states its topology the
+        # way a process does, by publishing one.
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import publish, reset_context
+        from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"), role="test")
+
+    def test_v1_only_backend_rejected_with_sidecar_pools(self):
+        group = _group()
+        controller = _controller(group)
+
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
+            _attach(controller, V1OnlyBackend(), host_pools=group.entries)
+
+        self.assertIn("batch_exists_v2", str(ctx.exception))
+        self.assertIn("mamba", str(ctx.exception))
+
+    def test_v2_backend_attaches_with_sidecar_pools(self):
+        group = _group()
+        controller = _controller(group)
+
+        _attach(controller, V2Backend(), host_pools=group.entries)
+
+        self.assertTrue(controller.enable_storage)
+
+    def test_v1_only_backend_attaches_anchor_only(self):
+        # A flat KV stack (anchor entry only) never issues v2 transfers, so
+        # v1-only backends stay fully usable for plain MHA/MLA models.
+        group = HostPoolGroup([_entry(PoolName.KV, _fake_pool("kv"), is_anchor=True)])
+        controller = _controller(group)
+
+        _attach(controller, V1OnlyBackend(), host_pools=group.entries)
+
+        self.assertTrue(controller.enable_storage)
+
+    def test_gate_failure_rolls_the_attach_back(self):
+        group = _group()
+        controller = _controller(group)
+        backend = V1OnlyBackend()
+
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            _attach(controller, backend, host_pools=group.entries)
+
+        # The base attach's guarded section already rolled the backend back.
+        self.assertFalse(controller.enable_storage)
+        self.assertIsNone(controller.storage_backend)
+
+
+class TestDynamicSidecarGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        # The attach path resolves derived parallel widths (e.g. attn_dcp_size)
+        # from the published runtime context, so a case states its topology the
+        # way a process does, by publishing one.
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import publish, reset_context
+        from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"), role="test")
+
+    def test_dynamic_sidecar_on_v1_backend_rejected(self):
+        # Sidecars registered after attach (retraction backup pools, draft
+        # sidecars) go through register_host_pool_entry; a v1-only backend
+        # must be rejected there too, before the entry lands in the group.
+        group = HostPoolGroup([_entry(PoolName.KV, _fake_pool("kv"), is_anchor=True)])
+        controller = _controller(group)
+
+        _attach(controller, V1OnlyBackend(), host_pools=group.entries)
+
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
+            controller.register_host_pool_entry(_entry(PoolName.SWA, _fake_pool("swa")))
+
+        self.assertIn("batch_get_v2", str(ctx.exception))
+        # The entry must not have been added despite the late rejection.
+        self.assertNotIn(PoolName.SWA, group.entry_map)
+
+    def test_dynamic_sidecar_on_v2_backend_accepted(self):
+        group = HostPoolGroup([_entry(PoolName.KV, _fake_pool("kv"), is_anchor=True)])
+        controller = _controller(group)
+
+        _attach(controller, V2Backend(), host_pools=group.entries)
+        controller.register_host_pool_entry(_entry(PoolName.SWA, _fake_pool("swa")))
+
+        self.assertIn(PoolName.SWA, group.entry_map)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

This adds an attach-time check that rejects v1-only storage backends on multi-pool cache stacks instead of crashing mid-serving with a bare NotImplementedError on the first v2 transfer.
